best: Clearly titled blocks with explanatory notes, and power paths (pack FETs, four-switch buck-boost, Kelvin shunt filter, cell RC inputs) drawn as recognisable textbook left-to-right circuits with real wires.
worst: Stacked hidden-pin numbers and GPIO11 text overlap at the bottom of the TPS25751 (U401/U501) body
Charger gate/switch nodes (HG1/LG1/SW1/HG2/LG2/SW2) and PD-to-charger I2C link the USB blocks only by net labels, so the power stage must be traced by name
Uneven page use: 3V3 and MCU sheets leave large empty areas while the antenna match and RSTN/C303 area on the MCU sheet are cramped
